'''Poolin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived in [[Torbel]], a village on the planet Lanteeb during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She was given a comlink after [[Jacklin]] and [[Devi (miner)|Devi]] convinced [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to provide shelter for the villagers.
